description: Read the latest bundled official CBAM certificate price for cost estimates. Use this for price alone; cbam_get_default_values combines it with emissions for a product. Returns unit (EUR per certificate, one tonne CO2e), latest period/price/publication date, history, next expected publication and Commission sources. Prices are copied from the Commission on publication: quarterly in 2026, weekly from 2027; check latest.published rather than assuming a live quote. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.
name: cbam_get_certificate_price
title: Get CBAM certificate price
